windowsVersioning.blocker: Windows installers do not distinguish Build 8 from a later Build with the same SemVer

runtimeDependencies.name: Codex CLI
runtimeDependencies.impact: workspace app-server features unavailable; shell startup is not statically blocked

runtimeDependencies.name: repository/current working directory
runtimeDependencies.impact: dictation model root has a cwd fallback when app_data_dir resolution fails

decisionRequired.question: Select one canonical Windows installer/scope or fund behavioral parity across MSI and NSIS
decisionRequired.recommended: NSIS per-user as the daily-use baseline; keep MSI non-authoritative until its shortcut and privilege contract is aligned

decisionRequired.question: Choose offline bundled runtime/installer, embedded bootstrapper, or explicit prerequisite behavior
decisionRequired.recommended: offline installer for deterministic network-silent acceptance, accepting the larger artifact

decisionRequired.question: Define how every publishable Windows build advances Windows-visible version identity
decisionRequired.recommended: require a SemVer bump for every published installer while retaining monotonic Build as internal authority

acceptanceCases.name: Clean Source Build
acceptanceCases.precondition: clean checkout at frozen commit; no main-checkout local files
acceptanceCases.action: run repository Windows production build wrappers
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: MSI and NSIS are generated from VERSION and release identity authority
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: build reads user-local BAT files or main-checkout modifications
acceptanceCases.destructiveScope: isolated worktree and external Cargo target only

acceptanceCases.name: Installer Payload
acceptanceCases.action: inspect MSI tables, generated WiX/NSIS sources, and extracted payload read-only
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: main and daemon binaries are colocated; required resources are present
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: daemon exists only in Cargo output or installer depends on repo paths

acceptanceCases.name: Install
acceptanceCases.precondition: clean disposable Windows Sandbox or VM snapshot
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: canonical installer completes at documented scope and location
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: hidden dev-tool/repository dependency or unexplained elevation

acceptanceCases.name: First Launch
acceptanceCases.precondition: case C installed; no repo or developer toolchain
acceptanceCases.action: launch from installed Start Menu shortcut
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: installed shell starts and remains responsive
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: lookup of dist, target, worktree, repo, Node, Rust, CMake, or LLVM

acceptanceCases.name: Fresh Profile Bootstrap
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: prepared profile validates before activation and current process reaches READY
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: implicit legacy migration, cwd fallback, or premature business access

acceptanceCases.name: Existing Legacy Migration
acceptanceCases.precondition: sanitized synthetic legacy profile in disposable guest
acceptanceCases.action: preview, confirm, retire synthetic identity, activate, and validate
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: only allowlisted state migrates and restart boundary is enforced
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: credential/canonical data copy or real-user data access

acceptanceCases.name: App Restart
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: same identity/profile loads after current-process validation
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: new UUID, repeat migration, or duplicate daemon
acceptanceCases.cleanup: stop guest processes and revert snapshot

acceptanceCases.name: Start Menu Shortcut
acceptanceCases.action: inspect and launch the created Start Menu shortcut
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: shortcut exists and targets installed main executable
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: shortcut targets build tree or missing executable

acceptanceCases.name: Desktop Shortcut Opt-out
acceptanceCases.action: verify default checked, then opt out before installation completes
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: no Desktop shortcut is created after opt-out
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: unconditional Desktop shortcut or default unchecked

acceptanceCases.name: Daemon Availability
acceptanceCases.action: exercise app-owned daemon discovery/start in guest
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: daemon is found beside main executable and authenticated readiness succeeds
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: Cargo-target lookup, PATH-only lookup, or missing daemon
acceptanceCases.cleanup: stop guest daemon and revert snapshot

acceptanceCases.name: Dev-tool Independence
acceptanceCases.precondition: guest has no Node, npm, Rust, Cargo, CMake, LLVM, repo, or local BAT files
acceptanceCases.action: launch and use core app shell
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: core app and daemon readiness work; optional dependency failures remain scoped
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: core startup failure from absent developer toolchain

acceptanceCases.name: Updater and Network Silence
acceptanceCases.precondition: network-observed disposable guest with chosen WebView2 strategy
acceptanceCases.action: install and launch while capturing process/network activity
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: no updater or telemetry request; only explicitly approved product traffic
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: Dimillian updater, Sentry, or undisclosed installer bootstrap traffic
acceptanceCases.cleanup: discard capture and revert snapshot after evidence export

acceptanceCases.name: Uninstall
acceptanceCases.precondition: installed guest package with retained test data
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: program files, shortcuts, and uninstall entry are removed at documented scope
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: unexpected app-data deletion or unrelated registry deletion

acceptanceCases.name: Reinstall
acceptanceCases.precondition: case M completed with retained test profile
acceptanceCases.action: install same canonical package again and launch
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: package registration and retained profile remain coherent
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: new identity, data loss, or duplicate install registration

acceptanceCases.name: Upgrade Same Product Identity
acceptanceCases.precondition: two signed-off test packages with defined Windows-visible version progression
acceptanceCases.action: install older package then upgrade with newer package
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: one product identity upgrades in place and retains allowed data
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: side-by-side duplicate, downgrade ambiguity, or same-version conflict

acceptanceCases.name: Data Retention on Uninstall
acceptanceCases.precondition: installed guest app with sentinel profile data
acceptanceCases.action: uninstall once with default choices and once with explicit delete-data choice where supported
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: default retains data; explicit destructive choice is clear and bounded

acceptanceCases.name: Wrong or Corrupt Profile Fail-closed
acceptanceCases.precondition: guest contains malformed, future-schema, wrong-root, and retired-identity fixtures
acceptanceCases.action: launch installed app and direct daemon entrypoints against each fixture
acceptanceCases.expectedResult: bootstrap/recovery UI or explicit error; zero business initialization
acceptanceCases.forbiddenResult: default profile generation, cwd fallback, auto-connect, or business access
